passage.title_en: AUTO INSURANCE CLAIM PROCESS — Fast Guard Insurance
passage.text_en:
AUTO INSURANCE CLAIM PROCESS — Fast Guard Insurance

IMMEDIATE STEPS (Within 24 hours of incident):
1. Call our 24/7 hotline: 1-800-CLAIM-01
2. Obtain police report number if accident involves:
   - Injuries to any party
   - Property damage exceeding $2,000
   - Hit-and-run situations

DOCUMENTATION REQUIRED (Submit within 5 business days):
- Completed claim form (online or paper)
- Photos of all vehicle damage (minimum 4 angles)
- Contact information for all parties involved
- Witness statements, if available
- Police report (if applicable)

RENTAL CAR COVERAGE:
Approved for accidents where your vehicle is undrivable. Maximum: $45/day for up to 14 days while repairs are in progress. Luxury and premium vehicles not covered.

CLAIM REVIEW:
Initial review: 3–5 business days after complete documentation.
Payment/repair authorization: 7–10 business days post-review.
Incomplete submissions will delay processing by 10–15 business days.

questions.prompt_en: What is the maximum total rental car reimbursement?
questions.prompt_ar: ما الحد الأقصى لإجمالي تعويض إيجار السيارة؟

questions.prompt_en: If you submit incomplete documentation, how long total might it take before payment/repair authorization?
questions.prompt_ar: إذا قدمت وثائق غير مكتملة، كم قد تستغرق المعالجة الكلية قبل اعتماد الدفع؟
questions.explanation_ar: تأخير 10–15 يوماً + مراجعة 3–5 + اعتماد 7–10 = يقارب 20–30 يوم عمل.
